title: Charon of Thebes
summary: Raleigh names Charon of Thebes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Charon, into whose house the seuen banished men passed at Thebes. He is not the Charon of the infernall ferrie, if any such were stored. The one-word title would not say which, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter XI, §. XI, sig. 452a–452b
